design.model: authors model 19 (RL+CK), released_code_intended, scoring pi=0, bias fixed 2.5
design.fold: fit S1-S4 training choices; score S5 by causal replay (previously inspected validation)
design.anchor: each participant's saved unconstrained alpha_CK added to its grid
design.delta_nll: (deviance(alpha) - min(saved deviance, all constrained deviances))/2, nats
design.s5_effect: s5_loss(alpha) - s5_loss(saved fit); positive = worse on S5; per choice
design.fixed_nuisance: secondary: saved beta_CK, alpha_RL, beta_RL held fixed; not a profile likelihood
design.final_test: never read: permitted_inputs exposes only training/initialization tables
